name: hertz-replay-safe-http-write-attribution
instr:
Give Hertz callers reliable evidence of how much HTTP output may have reached a peer when a write fails. Carry that evidence through HTTP/1 framing so client replay, connection reuse, server recovery, and tracing share the same immutable delivery outcome. Preserve existing behavior for callers that do not opt into delivery tracking.

Every built-in writer, including generic networkWriter, standard connections, and netpoll connections, reports truthful staged, attempted, accepted, remaining, completion, and replayability state, retaining only recoverable output and never claiming inaccessible bytes. Receipts identify successive flush attempts monotonically, while snapshots remain stable under repeated or concurrent observation. `NewWriter` and `DeliveryWriter` from `github.com/cloudwego/hertz/pkg/network` add this evidence without changing legacy `Writer.Flush` errors or successful output. HTTP/1 request, fixed-response, and chunked-response serialization attributes failures across start-line, headers, fixed or chunked body, terminator, and trailer framing without changing successful wire bytes or resetting a chunked response's delivery sequence. `DeliveryError`, `Error`, and `Unwrap` from `github.com/cloudwego/hertz/pkg/protocol/http1` preserve the backend cause, immutable receipt, phase, ambiguity, and backend message. `ReplayDecision`, `ReplayPolicy`, and `SetReplayPolicy` from `github.com/cloudwego/hertz/pkg/app/client` permit ambiguous replay only when explicitly authoriz
